source: Chapter 28 Floodplain Management / IB120 / Development Process Guide

rules.explanation: If the parcel is in the KCMO regulatory floodplain, a Floodplain Development Permit Application is needed.

rules.finding: Floodplain status could not be verified
rules.explanation: Confirm floodplain status in KCMO Parcel Viewer / floodplain mapping before filing.

rules.finding: Right-of-way / driveway / curb / sidewalk review may be required
rules.explanation: Work affecting curb, sidewalk, driveway approach, or public ROW typically needs separate public-works coordination.

rules.finding: Major public improvement plan review may be required
rules.explanation: Major public infrastructure plans are distinct from minor sidewalk/curb/driveway approach work.
